messages:
diego: Hey team, first day! Using macOS (M2) and trying to get a consistent Rust workflow: I installed rust via the asdf rust plugin, but some repo CI and VS Code devcontainer expect rustup-managed toolchains. Inside the container cargo builds fail because native mac libs aren't available. Any recommended local vs container setup so I can run and debug with lldb on mac, but build the linux image reproducibly?

rachel: welcome diego! :wave: We usually keep two environments: 1) local (mac) for iterative edit + debug with lldb, installed via rustup or asdf configured to delegate to rustup; 2) container (linux) for CI-like builds. To keep asdf and rustup from fighting, set `ASDF_RUSTUP_INIT=1` or configure the asdf rust plugin to use rustup shim.

diego: can you show the exact env change? I tried `ASDF_RUSTUP_INIT` but not sure where to put it.

tom: put it in your dotfiles or direnv for the project: add `export ASDF_RUSTUP_INIT=1` to `~/.profile` or `.envrc`. Also ensure `~/.asdf/shims` is at front of PATH. That way `rustup` is the underlying manager and `asdf` just ensures shims.

rachel: for container builds, the trick is to cross-compile or build inside a linux devcontainer. In devcontainer.json we use a bind mount of source and run `docker build` or `cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`. Add `rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` in the container setup.

diego: ok. And for lldb debugging, I need to run the binary on mac to attach lldb, but it will be linked differently than linux binary. Is that fine?

lina: yep for debugging you run the mac binary locally. Use cargo to build with `--debug` locally and attach `lldb target/debug/mybin`. For reproducing issues seen in the container, build in the container and use `gdb` or `lldb-server` inside container + remote attach from host if you need a native unix debugger. We have a small helper in repo `scripts/debug_remote.sh` that starts `lldb-server gdbserver` in container and forwards a port. Ping me if you want it.

devtools-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist 1: please mark "dev env configured" when you can run `cargo build` locally and inside the devcontainer: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/12345

diego: thanks all! I'll add ASDF_RUSTUP_INIT to my dotfiles and try the container target. Lina, I'll ping for the debug helper. Appreciate the quick tips :+1:
